_comment: Weekly snapshots of the OPEN CommitFest, used to compute week-over-week deltas. Only the MOST RECENT week is kept in full (needed to track the fate of a patch flagged a week ago); every earlier week is collapsed to {week, cf, created_n, closed_n, net}. Full history lives in references/archive/commitfest-2026.json (not read at runtime).

weeks.highlight: Flow reverses sharply against last week: -14 net on 2026-09-07 (20 created / 17 closed after the SQL/PGQ cull... recorded net 3) versus >= +19 now, as PG20-3 fills up while PG20-2 is the in-progress CF absorbing the commits. All 7 closures were 'Closed in commitfest PG20-2 with status: Committed' after being moved out of PG20-3; two of them (pgoutput streamed-2PC cleanup, SHMEM_ATTACH_UNKNOWN_SIZE) were created AND committed inside the same week. Standout new entry is Peter Geoghegan's INDEX_PAGES_LIMIT split out of the VISITED_PAGES_LIMIT thread.
